correctness.rationale: Narasimhan–Seshadri identifies stability of Sym^k E with irreducibility of Sym^k V for its compact SU2 closure. Clebsch–Gordan End(Sym^k V)=⊕_{j=0}^k Sym^{2j} V links first failure to least positive even invariant degree 2k. Binary dihedral/torus-normalizer and tetrahedral cannot have first m=4 or 6; binary octahedral and icosahedral have first invariant degrees 8 and 12. Classical invariant hypersurfaces give weighted E7/E8 rings. Independently checked relation weights (18,30) and Molien leading group-order coefficients, which alone are not a proof of group classification.
